title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
1. Working hours > 1.1 Duration
The standard schedule at DataFlow Brasil is 8 hours per day and 44 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with a lunch break of at least 1 hour.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
1. Working hours > 1.2 Time tracking
Every employee clocks in and out in the electronic time-tracking system. Recording is mandatory and is the basis for overtime calculations.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
2. Overtime > 2.1 Definition
Overtime is time worked beyond the standard 8 hours per day. The limit is 2 overtime hours per day, so a maximum of 10 hours worked in one day.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
2. Overtime > 2.2 Premium
- **Working days:** a 50% premium over the regular hourly rate. - **Sundays and public holidays:** a 100% premium over the regular hourly rate. - Compensatory time off replaces payment only if it is agreed in writing with the employee.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
2. Overtime > 2.3 Calculation example
An employee with a monthly salary of R$ 6,000.00 (220 hours per month): - Regular hourly rate: R$ 27.27 - Overtime on a working day (50%): R$ 40.91 - Overtime on a Sunday or holiday (100%): R$ 54.55

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
2. Overtime > 2.4 Working on Sundays
Sunday work happens only when authorized by management and follows the published schedule. The 100% premium in section 2.2 applies.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
legal_basis: CLT arts. 58, 59 and 74; Federal Constitution art. 7, XIII and XVI
text:
3. Daily limit
The total limit is 10 hours per day, counting regular hours and overtime. Work beyond that limit happens only in exceptional cases, with immediate notice to HR.

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
text:
1. Vacation entitlement > 1.1 Acquisition period
After 12 months of employment, the employee earns the right to vacation. This period is called the acquisition period.

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
text:
1. Vacation entitlement > 1.2 Duration
Each acquisition period gives the right to **30 consecutive days** of vacation, paid with an additional one-third of the salary.

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
section: 1. Vacation entitlement > 1.3 Reduction for unjustified absences
text:
1. Vacation entitlement > 1.3 Reduction for unjustified absences
The number of vacation days decreases with unjustified absences during the acquisition period: | Unjustified absences | Vacation days | |---|---| | up to 5 | 30 days | | 6 to 14 | 24 days | | 15 to 23 | 18 days | | 24 to 32 | 12 days | | more than 32 | the employee loses the right to vacation for that period |

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
text:
2. Splitting
Vacation can be split into up to 3 periods. One of them must have at least 14 days, and each of the others at least 5 days.

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
text:
3. Request
Vacation requests are submitted in the HR system at least 30 days before the start date. Approval depends on the team's schedule.

title: Vacation
legal_basis: CLT arts. 129 to 143; Federal Constitution art. 7, XVII
text:
4. Cash-out of vacation
The employee may convert up to one-third of the vacation (10 days) into cash. The request must be made up to 15 days before the end of the acquisition period.

title: FGTS and Notice Period
text:
1. FGTS > 1.1 Monthly deposit
The company deposits **8% of the gross salary** every month into the employee's FGTS account. FGTS is Brazil's mandatory severance guarantee fund.

title: FGTS and Notice Period
text:
1. FGTS > 1.2 Checking the balance
The FGTS balance can be checked in the Caixa Econômica Federal app, using the employee's PIS or NIS number.

title: FGTS and Notice Period
section: 2. Notice period > 2.1 Dismissal without cause (initiated by the company)
text:
2. Notice period > 2.1 Dismissal without cause (initiated by the company)
- 30 days of notice. - Plus 3 days for each full year of service. - Total limit of 90 days. - *Example:* 2 full years of service gives 36 days of notice.

title: FGTS and Notice Period
section: 2. Notice period > 2.2 Resignation (initiated by the employee)
text:
2. Notice period > 2.2 Resignation (initiated by the employee)
- The employee must work **30 days** of notice. - There are no extra days for length of service in this case.

title: FGTS and Notice Period
section: 2. Notice period > 2.3 Waiving the notice period
text:
2. Notice period > 2.3 Waiving the notice period
If both parties agree, the notice period may be shortened. The agreement must be in writing.
